hint.en: The camera saw motion. Comes with a picture.
A scenario set up in AXIS Object Analytics on the camera, for example a person in the driveway.
The camera's view was covered, blurred or changed all at once (for example turned away), or a door station felt a knock or shock.
A digital input on the camera (for example a door contact wired to it) or a virtual input changed.
The camera's audio detection heard a sound above its trigger level.
For advanced use: every event the app listens to, with its name and details.
The camera's audio analytics recognised a sound, for example breaking glass. Needs a camera with a microphone and audio analytics switched on.

A crossline counting scenario in AXIS Object Analytics counted a person or vehicle crossing its line. The totals are since the counts were last reset (at midnight, or with the 'Reset the counts' card).
For example the casing was opened, the SD card failed or the camera got too hot.

title.en: Someone started or stopped watching live

hint.en: The camera's live video was opened or closed, in Homey or anywhere else.

title.en: A camera schedule started or ended

hint.en: A schedule set up in the camera (Settings > System > Events > Schedules).

title.en: People or vehicles in view changed

hint.en: Only when 'Count people and vehicles in view' is switched on in the device settings.

title.en: A person or vehicle was detected

hint.en: Each new person or vehicle the camera's Object Analytics recognises. Needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on in the device settings. The picture is the camera's own close-up when it sends one. Colour example: pick 'red' to react only to a person in a red top or red trousers, or a red car. Top, trousers, bag, hat, licence plate and speed are filled in when the camera reports them (speed needs a radar camera).

title.en: A person or vehicle went past

hint.en: Runs when a person or vehicle leaves the picture, with the way it went. Example: a car going right to left in the picture could be 'leaving the driveway'. Give each direction your own name in the device settings (under 'People and vehicles'). Needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on in the device settings.

label.en: away from the camera (bottom to top)

title.en: A person or vehicle stays in view

titleFormatted.en: A [[type]] has been in view for [[minutes]] minutes

hint.en: Runs once for each person or vehicle that stays in the picture this long. Example: 2 minutes for someone hanging around the gate, 10 minutes for a car parked outside. The camera may stop following objects that stand completely still for a long time. Needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on in the device settings.

Runs when the camera sees clearly more than usual for this hour, or anything at an hour when there is normally nothing (for example 03:00). It learns what is usual by itself, so it only starts after a week. At most once an hour. Motion works on every camera; people and vehicles need 'Track and count people and vehicles' on in the device settings.

title.en: Traffic summary at a set time

hint.en: Runs every day at the time you pick, with a sentence like 'Today: 34 people, 12 cars and 3 bicycles. Busiest hour 17:00 (9).' Use the Summary tag in a notification or have a speaker read it out. Cameras without 'Track and count people and vehicles' give a motion summary instead.

example.en: Today: 34 people, 12 cars and 3 bicycles. Busiest hour 17:00 (9).

hint.en: The camera's PIR sensor reacts to warm bodies (people, animals) moving in front of it. It's fooled less often than motion in the picture: rain, shadows and changing light don't set it off. It doesn't notice someone who stands still.

title.en: Someone was blocked for wrong logins

hint.en: The camera blocked an address after too many wrong passwords. Someone may be trying to get into your camera.

title.en: Sound went past the camera's limit

hint.en: The limits are set on the camera's own web page (Audio → Sound pressure level).
A visitor pressed the call button on the door station (it starts calling). The picture is taken at that moment.
Calls on the door station: calling, ringing, active (talking) and idle (ended).
Someone typed a code on the door station's keypad. The digits are only filled in when the door station is set to send them (it hides them by default).

title.en: A card or tag was shown

hint.en: Someone held an RFID card or key fob to the door station's reader. The number is only filled in when the door station is set to send it.

title.en: The door station allowed or refused entry

hint.en: From the door station's own entry list (codes and cards it knows).

title.en: Someone is at the door station

hint.en: The door station noticed someone in front of it (for example the screen woke up).
The camera's Object Analytics found a face and sent a close-up. Only cameras that report faces; needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on.
The camera's Object Analytics found a licence plate and sent a close-up. The plate number is filled in only on cameras that read plates. Needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on.
An 'Occupancy in area' scenario in AXIS Object Analytics: how many people and vehicles are in its area right now.

title.en: A person or vehicle !{{is|is not}} in view

hint.en: Is the camera seeing one right now? Example: when the doorbell rings AND a person is in view of the garden camera. Needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on in the device settings.

title.en: !{{More|Not more}} than a number in view

hint.en: Counts the people or vehicles the camera sees right now. Example: more than 3 people in the garden. Needs 'Track and count people and vehicles' on in the device settings.

title.en: More than a number in an area

hint.en: Gives a picture you can send in a notification.
For PTZ cameras: move to a preset position saved in the camera.
For PTZ cameras.
The camera's IR or white light. Needs an operator or administrator account.
Virtual inputs start the camera's own action rules, for example recording to its SD card. Seconds are only used for 'Pulse'.
A digital output on the camera, for example a relay that opens a gate. Seconds are only used for 'Pulse'.

Gives a sentence like 'Today: 34 people, 12 cars and 3 bicycles. Busiest hour 17:00 (9).' to use in the next cards, for example in a notification. Works in Advanced Flows. Cameras without 'Track and count people and vehicles' give a motion summary instead.

title.en: Turn privacy mode on or off

hint.en: Covers the whole picture, so live view and recordings show nothing, for example while you're at home. Needs the camera's administrator account.
Plays one of the sounds stored on the camera (camera web page: Audio → Audio clips), through its speaker or a paired network speaker. Volume 0–100; leave empty for the camera's own volume.
For Axis devices with a siren or strobe light. Profiles are made on the device's web page.

The camera itself restarts: no picture, live view, recording or events for about a minute. The device shows 'restarting' until it's back. For when a camera hangs. Needs a camera user with Administrator rights.
For example 'Away mode' or the outside temperature. The text stays until you change or remove it. The same card again changes the text.

title.en: Remove the text from the picture

hint.en: Sets a crossline counting scenario in AXIS Object Analytics back to 0.
Makes the scenario give its alarm for 3 seconds, to try out your flows and the camera's own rules.
